column1: Co-op Bank Fleet Africa Leasing Limited

 The Bank entered into a Leasing business joint venture with Super Group of South Africa. The Joint
Venture has been registered as Co-op Bank Fleet Africa Leasing Limited
 The joint venture will take advantage of key strengths by the two partners and focus on the emerging
opportunities in leasing business with the bank providing a 7.6 million customer base and Super Group
providing proven products, technology and the expertise on running a scalable leasing business.
 Grow our Loan Book  Grow our Leasing Customer Base  Grow our Revenues
